Civil Service System Pilot Program Chronicle

国家公务员制度试点工作大事记

What this is

Below is an interactive explorer for the chronicle of significant events in China’s civil service system pilot program, covering 1986–1992. The entries are drawn from 国家公务员制度试点辑要, a reference volume documenting the policy discussions, legislative drafts, pilot implementations, and institutional decisions that led to the 1993 Interim Regulations on Civil Servants.

Dates marked with only a month and year (e.g., “Apr 1986”) indicate that the source records the month but not the specific day. Where a date range is recorded, both start and end dates appear in the entry header.
